prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic full-body street-fashion portrait of a ruggedly handsome Black man walking confidently toward the camera on a downtown Philadelphia sidewalk. He has an athletic masculine build, short dark hair beneath a fitted black baseball cap, a neatly groomed full beard, small hoop earring, and a calm, serious expression.

Outfit
He wears a long camel-colored wool overcoat with broad lapels, open over an oversized plain white T-shirt. Pair it with relaxed light-wash blue jeans, including a large frayed rip across one knee and subtle distressed details. Finish with clean white high-top sneakers, a long minimalist gold pendant necklace, small earring, and a substantial gold wristwatch. The look is upscale contemporary streetwear with an effortless masculine edge.

Pose
Capture him mid-stride walking directly toward the camera, one hand casually inside his jeans pocket while the opposite arm hangs naturally. His coat falls open and moves subtly with his stride. He looks slightly past the camera with relaxed, self-assured body language.

Environment
Set the scene in Center City Philadelphia, with historic stone buildings, townhouse steps, black wrought-iron railings, greenery, streetlights, traffic, pedestrians, and a Broad Street subway entrance. Philadelphia City Hall and its clock tower are clearly recognizable in the distance, giving the photograph an unmistakable Philadelphia identity while still feeling like a natural city moment.

Photography & Cinematography
Use premium contemporary street-fashion photography, full head-to-toe framing, eye-level perspective, and a 50–70mm lens look. Warm late-afternoon sunlight creates beautiful highlights along the camel coat and natural dimensional light across his face. Keep the subject tack-sharp with controlled background separation, realistic skin and beard texture, detailed wool and denim, natural city depth, subtle photographic grain, and exquisite editorial color grading.

Avoid: plastic or fake skin, excessive retouching, exaggerated muscles, overly formal styling, excessive logos, stiff posing, empty streets, artificial landmarks, excessive bokeh, CGI appearance, oversaturation, or fashion-doll aesthetics.

quotedPost.originalText:
PROMPT SHARE: Sometimes the energy of a video comes entirely from how you shoot and cut it.

#Lovart #LovartPartner @lovart_ai

This is why:

Quick cuts, shifting perspectives, push-ins, tracking shots. Every change gives your eye another reason to keep watching.

Lovart makes it easy to build fast, cinematic sequences without losing the creative direction. You can turn simple scenes into energetic, visually dynamic videos.

➜ Video Prompt:

Seedance 2.5 — Chicago Fashion Film

Visual quality: Hyper-realistic live-action fashion film. [character] is beautiful with model-like features. Real natural skin texture, pores, fine facial detail, and realistic light response. No fake skin, no plastic skin, no waxy skin, no overly smooth skin, no animated look, no CGI-looking face. Natural expressions and movement. No facial warping, morphing, or identity drift. Spectacular polished cinematography.

Performance: Keep [character] relaxed and natural. Most of the video is candid fashion-film movement rather than posing for the camera. She should only make direct eye contact when it naturally fits the shot.

Scene 1: [character] walks directly toward camera beneath the elevated Chicago L tracks, framed symmetrically beneath the dark steel structure. Wide frontal view, urban street activity behind her, confident natural walk.

Scene 2: Cut to a side-profile tracking shot of [character] walking through a narrow downtown alley beside a long brick wall covered in graffiti. She continues forward naturally, occasionally adjusting her hair or casually moving one hand as she walks.

Scene 3: Cut to [character] crossing a wide downtown Chicago intersection, shown mostly from the side as she walks through the crosswalk. Tall reflective glass buildings, traffic, and city architecture surround her.

Scene 4: Cut to [character] outside a modern fashion or streetwear storefront. She casually hangs out with a small group of stylish female friends with model-like features, talking, smiling, and reacting naturally to one another while pedestrians continue along the sidewalk. Keep the same relaxed sidewalk-group composition as the reference.

Scene 5: Cut to [character] standing on an elevated Chicago L platform beside a silver train. She waits casually near the train, relaxed posture, looking briefly along the platform before turning her attention forward.

Scene 6: Quick cut to [character] walking along a downtown sidewalk beside large glass storefront windows. Then another quick walking transition to a Chicago waterfront promenade, with the downtown skyline dramatically visible across the water. She walks naturally through the environment just as in the reference.

Scene 7: Cut to a wide view of [character] standing alone in the middle of an industrial Chicago street lined with red-brick buildings and overhead steel structures. The camera steadily moves closer from the wide shot into a tight portrait of her face. As the camera reaches her, she looks directly into the lens with a subtle change in expression, calm confidence shifting into the faintest soft smile. No blank stare. End on the close-up.

translations.zh:
创作一张超逼真的全身街头时尚肖像，展现一位英俊强壮的黑人男性自信地朝镜头走来，地点位于费城市中心的街道上。他体格健壮，戴着黑色棒球帽，留有整齐的胡须和小耳环，神情冷静沉着。

服装
他身穿一件剪裁宽松的驼色长款羊毛大衣，内搭宽松白色T恤，下着破洞浅蓝色牛仔裤与纯白高帮球鞋，佩戴金色吊坠项链及金色手表，展现高级现代街头风。

姿势
捕捉他在步履间的瞬间，一手插兜，大衣随步伐摆动，眼神略微偏离镜头，体态松弛自信。

环境
背景设在费城市中心，带有历史感石砌建筑、Broad Street地铁入口及远处的市政厅钟楼，展现真实城市街景。

摄影风格
采用现代街头时尚摄影风格，全身平视构图，50–70mm镜头感，温暖午后光线，清晰展现大衣面料与皮肤质感。

避免：塑料感皮肤、过度修图、假人质感及过度饱和。
